senses.gloss: ch. = h.כֹּלall, every one; any. Constr. כָּל (frequ. used absolutely).
units: <cite ref="Onkelos Genesis 16:12">Targ. O. Gen. XVI, 12</cite>, sq.

<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Deuteronomy 32:49">Targ. Y. Deut. XXXII, 49</cite> <he>לא כל היאך</he> not at all as (thou sayest); a. fr.—Y. Yoma VIII, 45ᵇ bot. <he>לא כולא מן הדין וכ׳</he> all does not depend upon this man (it is not at all within his power) to say to the king, Thou art no king, i.e. his saying that the Day of Atonement has no atoning power, cannot affect its power; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shevuot 2:2:3">Y. Shebu. II, 33ᵇ</cite> bot.—
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 46b:7">Snh. 46ᵇ</cite>, a. fr. (<he>לאו</he>) <he>לא כל כמיניה</he> all is not as if dependent on him, i.e. he has no power to &c.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 79">Gen. R. s. 79</cite>, beg. (expl. <he>בכלח</he>, <cite ref="Job 5:26">Job V, 26</cite>) <he>תבא בכולא אלי וכ׳</he> (some ed. <he>בכוֹלָּה</he>) thou shalt enter the grave in fulness, full, wanting nothing.—<he>כָּל דְּכֵן</he> = h. <he>כָּל שֶׁכֵּן</he>, v. <cite ref="K00668"><he>כֹּל</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Job 4:19">Targ. Job IV, 19</cite>; a. fr.—
Nidd. 51ᵃ; a. fr.—כָּל עלמא, v. infra.—With suffix כּוּלָךְ, כּוּלֵיה &c. (Buxt. כֻּלָּךְ &c.) all of thee, of him &c., entire.
<cite ref="Onkelos Genesis 25:25">Targ. Gen. XXV, 25</cite>; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Yoma 14b:1">Yoma 14ᵇ</cite> <he>כוליה יומא</he> the entire day; <cite ref="Yoma 19a:9">ib. 19ᵃ</cite> (not <cite ref="K00269"><he>כולי</he></cite>).
Ib. 26ᵃ כּוּלְהוּ מצפרא אתו (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 10) all of them come in (for their share) by the lots cast in the morning; a. fr.—Pl. constr. כּוּלֵי all of.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Esther 6:1">Targ. Esth. VI, 1</cite> <he>כ׳ ליליא</he> (ed. Lag. <he>כוליה</he>).
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Ecclesiastes 10:12">Targ. Koh. X, 12</cite> <he>כ׳ עלמא</he> (ed. Lag. <he>כוליה</he>).—
Y. Ber. II, 4ᵇ כ׳ עלמא ידעין ed. Lehm. (ed. כל) all the world, all people know (abbr. כ״ע); Y. M. Kat. III, 83ᶜ bot. כל עמא; v. עָלְמָא.
Kidd. 79ᵇ, v. כּוּל ch.—כ׳ האי all of that, to that extent.
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 84b:10">B. Mets. 84ᵇ</cite> <he>כ׳ ה׳ ודאי וכ׳</he> after it has come to all this (it being so well known), it is surely not proper.
<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 24a:11">Ab. Zar. 24ᵃ</cite>; a. v. fr.—

<cite ref="Chagigah 4b:10">Ḥag. 4ᵇ</cite> <he>כ׳ ה׳ ואולי</he> all this (is required of us) and yet only ‘perhaps’ (<cite ref="Zephaniah 2:3">Zeph. II, 3</cite>)! <cite ref="Taanit 25a:1">Taan. 25ᵃ</cite> <he>כ׳ ה׳ ואפשר</he> all this (trouble) and ‘only perhaps’!
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Peah 8:4:2">Y. Peah VIII, 20ᵈ</cite> bot. <he>לא כָּלָּן מסתור וכ׳</he> our (my) strength consists not in tearing down but &c.
